description: Implemented bounded semantic identity initialization, grammar composition, revision safety, and public-MCP static delivery; reference-led visual convergence is active and both current guard candidates are rejected
deviation_notes: Static implementation proceeded under delegated technical interchange authority while formal engine_interop closeout remained commit-gated. A generated structural reference target is selected and provenance-bound under delegated final orchestration authority. The compacted guard and the later first-class novel-feature candidate both pass mechanical public-MCP gates but fail side-by-side Kimi convergence: helmet/cranium, face readability, rounded proportions, and equipment balance remain materially wrong. S4 is active rather than deferred to the product owner; accepted sprites, final convergence lineage, and commit-gated closeout remain incomplete. Temporal animation is tracked separately and is not accepted here.

sprint.goal: Allow a fresh LLM to create original, distinct, versioned Forge identities through public MCP without source edits, then deliver portable source artifacts for downstream assembly.
sprint.demo_notes: See s4-rejected-iteration.md and the 2026-07-22 Kimi review. Mechanical public-MCP, determinism, GLB, manifest, and Pixel staging checks pass. The generated structural target is selected, but both current guard candidates fail visual convergence and are unadmitted.
